answer: Submitted answers form a derivation graph, and each task batch is sealed into an onyx slab whose payout splits only among distinct root vertices, one share per lineage. Because a clone farm descends from a single root, a thousand heads still collect exactly one share. The tide gauge rises with shared ancestry depth, so copying an existing vertex dilutes that lineage's stake super-linearly, and opening a fresh vertex demands an onyx stamp from an established non-kin peer, a witness no farm can clone.
